name: kmhblog
description: Linting and formatting tools for the blog. The site itself is built with Hugo.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:md && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:py && npm run format:check
scripts.format: prettier --write "static/css/**/*.css" && stylelint --fix "static/css/**/*.css" && markdownlint-cli2 --fix && ruff check --fix && ruff format
